title: Callback Window for Refunds and Fees Specialists — Personal Sender Account
content:
The fees callback window is a whole number of Paloma business days, Monday to Friday excluding US Federal Reserve holidays, and it governs callbacks on refunds and fees to Personal Sender Account holders only.

**Standard window.** The standard fees callback window is the callback time (in Paloma business days) of the level the account holds on the request date.

**Counted window.** The counted fees callback window of a callback starts from its standard fees callback window, and the fees callback window is the counted fees callback window.

**Due date.** The due date of a callback on refunds and fees is the request date plus the fees callback window, counted forward in Paloma business days from the request date.

## Basis Q&A

**Which level's callback time is used?** The callback time of the level the account holds on the date the callback is requested.

**Are weekends and holidays counted?** No. Only Paloma business days are counted: Saturdays, Sundays and US Federal Reserve holidays are skipped.

**Is the request date itself counted?** No. Counting runs forward from the request date, so the first business day after it is day 1.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A customer at a level whose callback time is 3 Paloma business days asks on a Wednesday for a callback on refunds and fees, in a fortnight with no US Federal Reserve holiday. The fees callback window is 3 business days: Thursday is day 1, Friday day 2 and the following Monday day 3, so the callback is due by that Monday.
